name: Khalil Center
mission: Khalil Center is a psychological and spiritual community wellness center advancing the professional practice of psychology rooted in Islamic principles.
theoryOfChange: Khalil Center utilizes a therapeutic framework called Traditional Islamically Integrated Psychotherapy (TIIP). This framework, originally published in 2013, integrates contemporary behavioral science into an Islamic framework, rooted in Islamic epistemological and ontological principles. TIIP outlines four overarching goals for psychotherapeutic encounters: Inkishāf (introspective self-discovery), Inqiyād (engendering treatment compliance & motivation), I'tidāl (equilibrium in all aspects of life), and Ittiḥād (holistic integration). Interventions within this framework are designed to target elements of the human psyche, including cognition (ʿaql), behavioral inclinations (nafs), spirit (rūḥ), and emotions (iḥsās). This approach is described as a structured model of Islamic psychotherapy that guides their clinical practice and aims to achieve holistic healing.
